turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Absolutely, starting strong makes a huge difference. How is the summer weather over in Portland today?

turns.text: We did! Grace and I went for a nice walk around the neighborhood. Also, I finally joined a tennis club this weekend.

turns.speaker: assistant

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Not yet, but I'm hoping to book a court and get out there later this week. I'm really looking forward to playing some matches.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: I'm sure you'll have a blast. Are you planning on doing any woodworking this week as well, or is tennis taking center stage?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'll probably do a bit of both. I have a small shelving project I've been meaning to finish up in the garage, so I might spend a few hours on that tomorrow.

turns.speaker: assistant
turns.text: Sounds like a perfect balance of active and creative time. Let me know if you need any help keeping track of your plans this week!

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Thanks! I think I'm all set for now. Just going to enjoy the rest of my Monday afternoon.
